title: FEWF W3 — XPS exterior insulation with OSB smart vapour-retarder layer
jurisdiction: NRC Field Exposure of Walls facility, Ottawa, Ontario, Canada (research specimen; no permit jurisdiction)
code_edition: Unknown; no project code edition is stated.

facts.text: The NRC report monitored three highly insulated wood-frame wall specimens at the Ottawa Field Exposure of Walls facility for approximately eight months.
W3 uses exterior XPS and an OSB smart vapour-retarder layer; the report distinguishes it from W1 by replacing the interior polyethylene vapour barrier with the smart layer.
facts.locator: PDF pp. 6–8, 18–19, 31–33; report Fig. 5 and Results §3

facts.text: The protocols introduced deliberate openings in air-barrier/sheathing layers to examine air leakage; the report says these deficiencies are not representative of correctly constructed in-service walls.
facts.locator: PDF pp. 21–25; report §2.3 and test-protocol figures

facts.text: The report observed condensation at the deliberately created slit and an elevated mould index; it reports a decline over the later monitoring period. This is a research result, not a project or permit decision.
facts.locator: PDF pp. 6–8, 18–19, 31–33; report Fig. 5 and Results §3
